detail.longDescription: I wrote in April that s6 was the right init system for Daemonless.io FreeBSD containers. dfr@'s kubernetes-on-FreeBSD ( https:// github.com/dfr/kubernetes-demo/ ) work changed my mind: under k8s, s6 hid crash loops and blocked runAsUser. Daemonless is now off of s6: base-exec (a small /init that execs the app) and base-rcd (a pinned version of bapt@'s rcd) for images that require several services. I still like s6, it helped the community scale daemonless.io to 120+ containers in a little less than a year, but it's not the right long term fit. https:// ahze.net/posts/moving-on-from- s6/ # FreeBSD # containers # kubernetes # daemonless
